name: What should I check before replacing a shower in a San Diego condo?

mainEntity.name: What should I check before replacing a shower in a San Diego condo?

acceptedAnswer.text: For a condo or HOA property in San Diego County, confirm building rules, work-hour limits, elevator or parking procedures, water-shutoff coordination, insurance documents, and approval steps before scheduling demolition. Context: These building requirements are separate from any city approval and can affect delivery, access, and timing. Key factors: shared walls; plumbing stacks; waterproofing responsibility; permitted work hours; debris routes; and inspection access. Practical guidance: Request the association’s remodeling packet and give it to the contractor before finalizing the scope. Elite Remodeling & Design can incorporate site-access and coordination requirements into the project plan when supplied in advance.
acceptedAnswer.description: Check HOA approval, work hours, elevator and parking rules, insurance requirements, water-shutoff procedures, debris routes, shared-wall restrictions, and any building-specific plumbing or waterproofing responsibilities. Provide the remodeling packet before scheduling work so the contractor can plan access, sequencing, and required approvals.
